articles.title: Brandon Sanderson Says He 'Would Love to' Create Tabletop Adaptations of His Cytoverse Books
articles.summary: Brandon Sanderson has been heavily invested in making tabletop adaptations of his Cosmere books. Most recently, he's been collaborating with Brotherwise Games on standalone board games as well as a larger Cosmere TTRPG.
body: IGN recently had the chance to interview Sanderson, and we asked him if he's considered making tabletop adaptations of Skyward and the rest of the Cytoverse.

"I would love to! We've talked about it. However, I also want to be aware of asking my fans for too much," Sanderson told IGN. "There are a lot of great books out there, and a lot of great games. I don't want or need it to be all Brandon Sanderson all the time. We try to be very deliberate and careful about these kinds of collaborations, to only be doing what will feel the most exciting to my fans."

Sanderson's answer here doesn't rule out the possibility of a Cytoverse tabletop adaptation, but it certainly indicates that it won't be happening any time soon. The release of Blightfall marks the first official book expansion into the Cytoverse, and it was recently revealed that a Skyward TV series is in the works.

articles.title: John Leguizamo, Who Made His TV Debut on Miami Vice, Reportedly Cast as the Villain in Miami Vice '85
articles.summary: Hot on the heels of his awards-buzzy performance in The Odyssey, John Leguizamo has reportedly landed a major role in another Universal film, one that will take him back to his roots: Miami Vice ‘85. The Hollywood Reporter understands that Leguizamo will play the film’s main villain, a cartel boss.
body: Unlike the 2006 feature film adaptation directed by Michael Mann and starring Jamie Foxx and Colin Farrell, this Miami Vice movie will be a period piece that Universal has said “explores the glamour and corruption of mid-'80s Miami.”

Director Joseph Kosinski’s movie is particularly inspired by the series pilot and first season (1984-85). A recurring villain in the first season was Columbian cartel lord Esteban Calderone, whose drug trafficking operations stretched from New York City to Miami and into the Bahamas. He first appeared in the pilot episode, “Brother’s Keeper,” and returned later in the season when an undercover Crockett and Tubbs went to the Bahamas to finally stop Calderone.

Leguizamo played the cartel boss’s vengeful son Orlando Calderone in two notable episodes, the first being the Season 2 finale and his second and final time as Orlando in a High Noon-style episode in Season 3. (In Season 5, Leguizamo played a different drug dealer character, Angelo Alvarez, in one episode.) Although the series was episodic, the hunt for Calderone was a main throughline of Miami Vice’s first season, so it’s possible that might also serve as the spine of Kosinski’s film.

articles.title: A New Hyperkin SupaBoy Portable SNES Handheld Is Up for Preorder
articles.summary: Hyperkin has announced a new model of its SupaBoy Portable game console that lets you play actual full-sized Super Nintendo and Super Famicom cartridges on a handheld gaming device. It comes in two translucent color options and is available for preorder now for $129.99 ( see it at Amazon ).
body: SupaBoy Portable is shaped basically like a bigger, bulkier SNES controller, with all the same buttons you’d find on the original hardware. In the middle of the device is a 4.3-inch screen; you can toggle between 4:3 and 16:9 aspect ratios using a button on the bottom of the handheld.

On the top of the device, you’ll find a slot for original SNES and Super Famicom cartidges. It’s region-free, so you don’t need to worry about compatibility between NTSC and PAL (there’s a switch to toggle between the two). The carts don’t slide all the way in. Instead, they stick out of the device to perfectly display the sticker art on the cartridge, just like in the original SNES hardware. Also just like the original, SupaBoy Portable is compatible with Super Gameboy, Game Genie, and EverDrive.

Below the controls you’ll find two controller ports that function exactly like you'd expect. That means you can plug in extra controllers to play multiplayer (though you and your friend may have to squint to see the screen). Or you can plug in accessories like the mouse for Mario Paint, the SNES Multi-Tap, or even third-party accessories.
points: Hyperkin has announced a new model of its SupaBoy Portable game console that lets you play actual full-sized Super Nintendo and Super Famicom cartridges on a handheld gaming device.

articles.title: Scientists Discovered A New Cat Before Rockstar Could Finish GTA 6
articles.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 has been in development since 2015, and a lot of things have happened since then, including the recent discovery a new species of cat. The scientific journal Current Biology disclosed the discovery of Leopardus tilcayo--known as the tilcayo tiger cat--this week.
body: The tilcayo tiger cat is the first new cat species discovered in over 100 years.

Paola Nogales-Ascarrunz, a co-author of the report, told NBC News that it is currently unknown how many of the cats remain in the wild. She said she discovered the cat basically by accident. She volunteers at a wildlife rehab facility close to La Paz, Bolivia and noticed a tiny cat that she thought was a kitten.

The cat was brought to the facility by a man who was caring for it, feeding it rice and eggs, and later giving it up when he was unable to care for it. Genetic testing was undertaken, and it was discovered that it was indeed a brand-new species of cat never before discovered or documented.

As for more gaming-related things that have happened since GTA 5 came out, GameSpot recently assembled a collection of some of the biggest news stories, including Halo coming to PlayStation, the release of 15+ Call of Duty games, the entire run of Phil Spencer as Xbox CEO, and more.

articles.title: 5 Canon-Shaking Star Wars Reveals From the New 'Andor' Prequel
articles.summary: Nobody was more surprised than Star Wars fans when Tony Gilroy’s gritty sci-fi drama about Cassian Andor's early years became one of the best things Lucasfilm has ever released.
body: Yet even Andor has flaws, including several unanswered questions. Thankfully, Star Wars is a franchise with heaps of supplementary material that often fills in the blanks — something the latest entry in the Reign of the Empire trilogy has done perfectly with Andor.

Star Wars: Edge of the Abyss by Rebecca Roanhorse is the second entry in the Reign of the Empire novel trilogy and a sequel to Alexander Freed's The Mask of Fear. Set a year before Andor season 1, Edge of the Abyss carefully lays the groundwork that leads readers to uncover answers to questions raised in Andor’s first and second seasons.

Anto Kreegyr was first introduced as a leading member of a Rebel cell who sacrificed everything to fight the Galactic Empire's oppression. Kreegyr ultimately died off-screen after Luthen Rael and Saw Gerrera failed to warn his group of an impending Imperial attack, showing how ruthless even Rebel cells could be with one another.

articles.title: 'Midnight Reckoning' quest walkthrough in The Blood of Dawnwalker
articles.summary: The "Midnight Reckoning" quest in The Blood of Dawnwalker will complete Coen's story, but it can either do so in a (somewhat) good way or a pretty bad way. While the final choice in "Midnight Reckoning" is important, though, getting there is half the challenge, especially if you get stuck in…
body: Here's what happens if you side with Brencis or stick with Lacra in The Blood of Dawnwalker 's "Midnight Reckoning" quest. We'll also show you how to escape the trap.

"Midnight Reckoning" forms the final part of Lacra's quest line, but more importantly, it's one of the endgame quests in The Blood of Dawnwalker, which means it will finish the main story. So, before you start, make sure you've done everything you wanted to do before confronting Brencis, and make sure you prefer "Midnight Reckoning" over any of the other endgame quests you might've unlocked (such as Crake's or Father Florin's final quest).

If you haven't unlocked "Midnight Reckoning" yet, you must follow Lacra's quest line first, starting with "A Friend Like This." After completing "Our Rotten Roots," you can optionally do the "Night of Horrors" quest (which contains a romance opportunity ), or go straight to "Midnight Reckoning."
Like every adventure with Lacra, you can only start "Midnight Reckoning" during the night. It won't cost any time segments.

articles.title: Wardogs Is Officially One of the Best FPS Games of the Decade
articles.summary: "Are you out in the open, or do you have some cover?" I asked my girlfriend as she got picked off by a sniper when we were approaching the hot zone. "I'm by a wall, so I have some cover, but not a lot," she replied. "I'll throw down a smoke and drag you around the corner to revive you.
body: In that match of Wardogs, I think I only had one kill after 20 minutes, but despite the lack of combat, I was having a blast. I was playing primarily as a spotter, tagging enemies with a monocular from afar, so their location was tracked on the minimap for everyone on my team, but I was also kitted out with medical equipment to revive any allies who needed it in my vicinity. In the following game, I spent most of my time with a hammer in hand, building a huge fortified base made up of Hesco blocks and barbed wire around a colossal tower that my team had secured.

Developed by Bulkhead and released this month on Steam in early access, Wardogs is a first-person shooter, but its beauty lies in the fact that you don't have to be competent with any sort of weapon to contribute to your team's efforts, and more importantly, to enjoy yourself. In the same way you can focus solely on exploration or base-building in No Man's Sky — or how in Old School RuneScape, you can focus entirely on one particular skill such as woodcutting, fishing, or combat — Wardogs caters to players who may not want to engage with the other disciplines.

articles.summary: It's official: Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil film is a hit with critics. The movie currently sits at a 96% rating on Rotten Tomatoes, making it the highest-rated video game movie on the site—it isn’t particularly close either.
body: After these first three entries, there are only six video game movies on the list with positive Tomatometer scores: The Angry Birds Movie 2, Sonic the Hedgehog 2, Pokémon Detective Pikachu, Gran Turismo, Sonic the Hedgehog, and Mortal Kombat II. Their scores range from 64% to 72%. This short list shows just how bad video game movies tend to be.

For clarity, the Tomatometer represents the percentage of critics who gave a movie a favorable review. This Rotten Tomatoes list excludes films that don’t have at least 20 reviews from theatrical releases. That said, the Rotten Tomatoes list consists of just a handful of movies. For instance, Exit 8, an adaptation of the game of the same name, has a 91% Rotten Tomatoes score with 176 reviews. Even so, Resident Evil is well ahead of the competition.

Until now, video game adaptations have fared dramatically better on the small screen than in theaters, with great TV shows like Cyberpunk: Edgerunners (100% on Rotten Tomatoes), Arcane (100%), Fallout (93%), The Last of Us (96%), Castlevania (94%), Nier: Automata Ver1.1a, and more.

articles.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker sequel may not have the divisive time mechanic that so many players dislike: 'We will not force it,' game director says
articles.summary: The Blood of Dawnwalker is a pretty excellent RPG, but there's one aspect of it that not everyone loves: Time. Simply put, it's a limited resource in the game, which restricts what Coen—that's you—can do.
body: Other players clearly felt the same way: One of the first mods to come out for The Blood of Dawnwalker is the " Better Story Timer," which effectively eliminates the impact of the ticking clock entirely—and which has since become, by far, the most popular Dawnwalker mod on Nexus Mods.

How much of an impact that reaction has had over at developer Rebel Wolves is impossible to say, but in an interview with Eurogamer, studio CEO and game director Konrad Tomaszkiewicz said it might not be used for the game's sequel.

"We will play with it. If we will have parts of the story, or the whole story, to which it fits, then we will use it," Tomaszkiewicz said. "If we will have stories where it does not fit, we will not force it. We will play with this system and we will try to use it to boost the urgency of some events in the game. But I'm not saying that in every game we will have the same scheme or loop—it's not like this."
points: The Blood of Dawnwalker is a pretty excellent RPG, but there's one aspect of it that not everyone loves: Time.

articles.title: Denuvo is on the hunt for DRM cracker 'voices38' as the company attempts to take one of its biggest foes to court
articles.summary: As reported by TorrentFreak, the ubiquitous DRM producer, Denuvo, is attempting to take one of its biggest foes to court over their work circumventing the antipiracy measures on games like Hogwarts Legacy and Black Myth: Wukong.
body: The target of the lawsuit, who goes by "voices38" on various channels, is particularly prolific when it comes to putting out DRM-circumventing patches or "cracks" for games that license Denuvo's copy protection software. Denuvo is suing voices38 under the anti-circumvention provisions of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (DMCA), which prohibits tampering with digital protections.

While voices38 is an anonymous actor, Denuvo lists a number of social and gaming services accounts associated with them in its filing, an indication that the company will likely subpoena Valve, Reddit, and/or Discord for identifying information. We saw a similar move from Rockstar recently as it attempted to uncover the identity of GTA6 leaker Cyberleek.

videos.summary: From the team at ArtPlay and 505 Games comes the latest trailer for Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement. Together, heroes Leo and Alex must rise against the Demon Lord Elias in order to free a kingdom from the evil forces that have held it captive.
body: Explore the series’ largest map yet, experience a dynamic day-night cycle, master new abilities with the Epiphany Combat System, and customise each hero with crafting, cooking, equipment and armour.
Bloodstained: The Scarlet Engagement launches on PlayStation 5 in 2027.
